route_gate: authorization and route readiness occur before hero asset load

stages.name: current-room-shell
stages.payload: room environment shell + current section camera anchors

stages.name: current-hero
stages.payload: current hero Tier selected by capability

stages.name: next-likely-room
stages.payload: warm cache only after current hero settles

stages.name: secondary-objects-on-demand
stages.payload: physical UI objects and noncritical props

section_scroll_rule: camera POV changes continuously within the loaded room; do not unload the room when a section changes
tab_rule: tab selection changes station camera target; local scroll refines POV inside the same room
door_rule: door navigation may load a destination room, but route authorization remains outside the asset loader
visibility_rule: hidden/backgrounded loops pause; offscreen secondary assets may be released
reduced_motion: prefer Tier 0/static or minimal deterministic motion
failure: any asset error resolves to poster/static fallback and emits non-blocking diagnostic event
